issues.quote: Gross profit reached $171.0 billion in fiscal 2024 versus $135.6 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2023 gross profit was about $146.1B; $135.6B is the FY2022 figure. Using it makes gross profit growth look like about 26% when it was actually about 17%.

data.summary: Most figures match Microsoft's reported results: revenue, operating income, net income, EPS, R&D and both FY2024 margins. The exception is FY2023 gross profit, which is given as $135.6B (the FY2022 figure) instead of about $146.1B.
